_meta.description: Central government schemes with machine-checkable eligibility rules. Amounts are the CENTRAL share; many states add top-ups, so the agent must say state amounts can differ.
_meta.rule_ops: eq, ne, gte, lte, in, any_child (sub-conditions over profile.children)

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.summary: Monthly pension for people aged 60+ from Below Poverty Line households.
schemes.benefits: Central share: Rs 200/month (age 60-79), Rs 500/month (age 80+). States add their own top-up, so the actual amount varies by state.

rules.reason: Applicant must be 60 or older
Household must be Below Poverty Line (BPL)

caveats: BPL status is decided by the state's BPL list.
Cannot draw this and the widow pension at the same time.
documents: Bank or post office account details
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / municipal office or the state social welfare portal.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.summary: Monthly pension for widows aged 40-79 from Below Poverty Line households.
schemes.benefits: Central share: Rs 300/month. At 80+ the widow is covered under the old age pension (IGNOAPS) at Rs 500/month. States add their own top-up.

rules.reason: Scheme is for women
Applicant must be a widow (not remarried)
Applicant must be 40 or older
Covers ages 40-79; from 80 the old age pension (IGNOAPS) applies instead
Household must be Below Poverty Line (BPL)

caveats: Eligibility ends on remarriage.
Cannot draw this and the old age pension at the same time.
Reported renamed in Oct 2026 to Pradhan Mantri Vidhwa Pension Yojana; check the current name with your state office.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / municipal office or the state social welfare portal.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.summary: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000-5,000/month from age 60, for savings account holders who join between 18 and 40.
schemes.benefits: Fixed monthly pension of Rs 1,000-5,000 from age 60, based on contribution (Rs 42-210/month if joining at 18; Rs 291-1,454/month if joining at 40).

rules.reason: Minimum joining age is 18
Maximum joining age is 40
Needs a savings bank or post office account
Since 1 Oct 2022, anyone who is or has been an income tax payer cannot join

caveats: Contributions continue until age 60.
schemes.how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank branch, post office, or net banking.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
schemes.summary: Rs 2 lakh life cover for Rs 436 a year, for account holders aged 18-50.
schemes.benefits: Rs 2 lakh paid on death from any cause. Premium Rs 436/year, auto-debited. Renewable up to age 55.

rules.reason: Minimum entry age is 18
Maximum entry age is 50
Needs a bank or post office account with auto-debit

caveats: Only accidental death is covered in the first 45 days after enrolment.
schemes.how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank branch, post office, or via net banking.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
schemes.summary: Rs 2 lakh accident cover for Rs 20 a year, for account holders aged 18-70.
schemes.benefits: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or total disability; Rs 1 lakh for partial disability. Premium Rs 20/year, auto-debited.

rules.reason: Minimum age is 18
Maximum age is 70
Needs a bank or post office account with auto-debit

schemes.how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank branch, post office, or via net banking.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY for senior citizens (Ayushman Vay Vandana Card)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (NHA)
schemes.summary: Free hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year for everyone aged 70+, regardless of income.
schemes.benefits: Cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh/year at empanelled hospitals. Families already under PM-JAY get an extra Rs 5 lakh top-up for the senior.

rules.reason: Applicant must be 70 or older (as per Aadhaar)

caveats: People under 70 may still qualify for regular PM-JAY based on SECC/state criteria; this tool cannot check that, so they should check on the Ayushman portal or app.
Aadhaar e-KYC is required.
People on CGHS/ECHS/CAPF can choose either that scheme or PM-JAY.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through the Ayushman app, the beneficiary.nha.gov.in portal, or an empanelled hospital.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: Rs 6,000 a year income support for landholding farmer families, with exclusions for higher-income groups.
schemes.benefits: Rs 6,000/year in three instalments of Rs 2,000, paid directly to the bank account.

rules.reason: Family must own cultivable land
Families where someone paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded
Serving/retired govt employees are excluded (except MTS/Class IV/Group D)
Retired pensioners with monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more are excluded

caveats: Also excluded: institutional landholders, current/former constitutional post holders, MPs/MLAs, and practising professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects).
e-KYC is mandatory.
Exclusion applies if ANY family member falls in an excluded category.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register on pmkisan.gov.in (Farmer Corner) or through a Common Service Centre.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
schemes.summary: Deposit-free LPG connection for an adult woman from a poor household that has no LPG connection.
schemes.benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection with government financial support for the connection cost.

rules.reason: Connection is given in the name of an adult woman
Applicant must be 18 or older
Household must not already have an LPG connection

caveats: The household must be poor: a BPL card holder, or an SC/ST household, PMAY-G beneficiary, AAY card holder, forest dweller or another listed deprived category (a deprivation declaration may be accepted). This tool cannot check that, so confirm with the LPG distributor.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at an LPG distributor or on pmuy.gov.in.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
schemes.summary: High-interest savings account for a girl child below 10, opened by a parent or guardian.
schemes.benefits: Government-backed savings with tax benefits; deposits Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh a year for 15 years; matures at 21 years.

rules.reason: Needs a daughter below 10 years of age

caveats: Maximum two accounts per family (three for twins/triplets).
Girl must be a resident Indian.
schemes.how_to_apply: Open at a post office or authorised bank branch.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.summary: Cash support for pregnant and lactating women: Rs 5,000 for the first child, Rs 6,000 for a second child if she is a girl.
schemes.benefits: Rs 5,000 for the first child (two instalments); Rs 6,000 for the second child if it is a girl (one instalment after birth).

rules.reason: Scheme is for pregnant/lactating women
Must be pregnant or a lactating mother
Women in regular employment with central/state govt or PSUs are excluded

caveats: Benefit covers only the first child, or the second child if she is a girl.
Must also belong to an eligible category (e.g. BPL card holder); this tool does not check category, so confirm at the Anganwadi centre.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at an Anganwadi centre, an approved health facility, or pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
schemes.summary: Monthly pension for disabled persons aged 18 years and above with 80% or more disability who belong to the Below Poverty Line.
schemes.benefits: A pension of Rs.300/- per month is provided to Divyangjan between 18-79 years. A pension of Rs.500/- per month will be provided to Divyangjan aged 80 years and above.

rules.reason: Applicant must be 18 years or older
Applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line
Disability must be 81% or more (more than 80%)

caveats: Applicant should be a resident of India
Applicant should be a physically or mentally disabled person
Dwarfs are also eligible for this scheme
A pension of Rs.300/- per month is provided to Divyangjan between 18-79 years
A pension of Rs.500/- per month will be provided to Divyangjan aged 80 years and above
documents: Age Proof - For age, the birth certificate or school certificate may be relied on. In their absence ration card and EPIC may be considered. If there is no valid document, any Medical Officer of any government hospital may be authorized to issue the age certificate.
Disability certificate:- Disability certificate (80% and More) issued from Chief Medical Officer, Community Health Centre or Primary Health Centre will be accepted.
schemes.how_to_apply: Online or Offline. One can download UMANG App or visit website https://web.umang.gov.in/web_new/home. The citizen can login using mobile number and OTP. Once logged In, citizen can search for NSAP. Click on “Apply Online”. Fill the basic details, choose the mode of payment of pension, upload photo and click on “Submit”.

schemes.name: National Family Benefit Scheme
schemes.summary: A family welfare scheme under the umbrella scheme ‘National Social Assistance Programme’ (NSAP) by MoRD. In this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the bereaved households in case of the death of the primary breadwinner irrespective of the cause of death.
schemes.benefits: ₹ 20000/ - will be given as a lump sum assistance to such surviving member of the household of the deceased poor, who after local inquiry, is found to be the head of the household.

rules.reason: The family of the applicant must be living Below Poverty Line (BPL)
The primary breadwinner of the applicant's family must have been deceased
The earning member must have been 19 or older (older than 18) when they died
The earning member must have been younger than 60 when they died

caveats: The applicant must be a citizen of India
The applicant must be the succeeding primary breadwinner of the family
The family benefit will be paid to such surviving member of the household of the deceased poor , who after local inquiry, is found to be the head of the household
The assistance would be given to every case of death of breadwinner in a family
documents: BPL Card / Ration Card of the Family
Details of the AADHAAR Seeded Bank Account / Post Office Account
schemes.how_to_apply: Offline or Online. Take a print of the application form given in Annexure-III (page no. 47) of the scheme guidelines - https://nsap.nic.in/Guidelines/nsap_guidelines_oct2014.pdf. The duly filled-in Application forms along with the required documents are to be submitted to the designated officer appointed by the respective state governments.

schemes.name: National Pension Scheme for Traders And Self Employed Persons
schemes.summary: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme providing a minimum assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining the age of sixty years to small-scale traders, retailers, and self-employed individuals.
schemes.benefits: Each eligible subscriber under this scheme shall receive an assured minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000/- after attaining the age of sixty years. The Government of India make a matching contribution into the subscriber's pension account every month.

rules.reason: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Applicant must be 40 years old or younger
Applicant must possess a savings bank account in their name
Applicant must not be a member of EPFO, ESIC or NPS
Income-tax payers are not eligible
Scheme is for traders and self-employed persons

caveats: Applicant must be a Laghu Vyapari, self-employed person, shop owner, retail trader, rice mill owner, oil mill owner, workshop owner, commission agent, real estate broker, small hotel owner, or restaurant owner.
The applicant must have an annual turnover that does not exceed ₹1,50,00,000/-.
The applicant must not be an income-tax payer or income-tax assessee.
Applicant must possess an Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Number.
The applicant must not be enrolled under the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana administered by the Ministry of Labour & Employment.
Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) (only required for those with an Annual Turnover above ₹40,00,000/-).
Self-Declaration Document for Annual Turnover Income.
documents: Savings Bank Account or Jan Dhan Bank Account Details
Bank Passbook, Cheque Leave/Book, or Copy of Bank Statement (as Evidence of Bank Account)
Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) (only required for those with an Annual Turnover above ₹40,00,000/-)
Self-Declaration Document for Annual Turnover Income
schemes.how_to_apply: Online - Via CSCs. The interested eligible person must visit their nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) to initiate the registration process offline. The applicant must carry prerequisites such as their Aadhaar Card and evidence of their bank account.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
schemes.summary: PM-GKAY is a scheme as part of Atmanirbhar Bharat to supply free food grains to migrants and poor, providing 5kg of free food grains per month to the poor in addition to subsidized ration under NFSA.
schemes.benefits: Under this scheme, the center provides 5kg of free food grains per month to the poor. This is in addition to the subsidized (Rs 2-3 per kg) ration provided under the National Food Security Act (NFSA) to families covered under the Public Distribution System (PDS).

rules.reason: Only Antyodaya (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration card families are covered

caveats: Families belonging to Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Households (PHH) categories will be eligible for the scheme
PHH are to be identified by State Governments/Union Territory Administrations as per criteria evolved by them
AAY families are to be identified by States/UTs as per the criteria prescribed by the Central Government
Households headed by widows or terminally ill persons or disabled persons or persons aged 60 years or more with no assured means of subsistence or societal support
Widows or terminally ill persons or disabled persons or persons aged 60 years or more or single women or single men with no family or societal support or assured means of subsistence
All primitive tribal households

Landless agriculture labourers, marginal farmers, rural artisans/craftsmen such as potters, tanners, weavers, blacksmiths, carpenters, slum dwellers, and persons earning their livelihood on daily basis in the informal sector like porters, coolies, rickshaw pullers, hand cart pullers, fruit and flower sellers, snake charmers, rag pickers, cobblers, destitutes and other similar categories in both rural and urban areas
All eligible Below Poverty Line families of HIV positive persons
Wheat has been allocated to 6 States/UTs, - Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Chandigarh, Delhi, and Gujarat, and rice has been provided to the remaining States/UTs
documents: Aadhar Card (if seeded with Ration Card)
schemes.how_to_apply: Interested persons shall visit the nearest Fair Price Shop with the Ration Card. Beneficiaries can quote either their ration card number or the Aadhaar number to any Fair Price Shop dealer across the country. Beneficiaries can undergo Aadhaar authentication by using their fingerprints or iris-based identification.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.summary: Old age protection and social security scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers providing a minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000 per month after age 60, with government matching contribution.
schemes.benefits: Minimum assured pension of ₹ 3,000 per month after attaining the age of 60 years; family pension of 50% to spouse; government matching contribution equal to subscriber's monthly contribution.

rules.reason: Applicant must be a Small or Marginal Farmer with cultivable landholding
Cultivable landholding must be up to 2 hectares
Applicant must be at least 18 years of age at the time of entry
Applicant must be 40 years of age or younger at the time of entry
People who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded
Serving or retired government employees are excluded
People covered by NPS, ESIC or EPFO are excluded

caveats: Applicant's name should appear in land records as on 01.08.2019
Applicant should possess an Aadhaar card
Applicant should have a savings bank account or PM-KISAN account

SMFs covered under any other statutory social security schemes such as National Pension Scheme (NPS), Employees’ State Insurance Corporation scheme, Employees’ Fund Organization Scheme are not eligible
Farmers who have opted for Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan Yojana and Pradhan Mantri Vyapari Maandhan administered by the Ministry of Labour & Employment are not eligible
All Institutional Landholders are not eligible
Former and present holders of constitutional posts are not eligible

Former and present Ministers/ State Ministers and former/present Members of Lok Sabha/ Rajya Sabha/ State Legislative Assemblies/ State Legislative Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and present Chairpersons of District Panchayats are not eligible

All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/ State Government Ministries/ Offices/Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and Attached offices/ Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of the Local Bodies (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV/Group D employees) are not eligible

All Persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practice are not eligible
Applicant should be a Small or Marginal Farmer

Exclusion: Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practice are not eligible
documents: Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code ( Bank Passbook or Cheque Leaf/book or copy of bank statement as evidence of bank account)
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online via Common Service Centres (CSCs); visit the nearest CSC with Aadhaar Card and Savings Bank Account Number along with IFSC Code, pay the initial contribution amount in cash to the Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE), and complete enrolment.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan
schemes.summary: A minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining the age of 60 years for unorganised workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income of ₹15,000 or less, with matching Central Government contribution.
schemes.benefits: A minimum assured pension of ₹3,000/- per month after attaining the age of 60 years; family pension equal to 50% of the pension for the spouse; matching contribution by the Central Government on a 50:50 basis where an equal amount to the subscriber's age-specific contribution (ranging from ₹55/- to ₹200/-) is credited to the pension account.

rules.reason: Applicant must be an unorganised worker
Entry age must be at least 18 years
Entry age must be 40 years or less
Monthly income must be ₹15,000 or less
Applicant must possess a Savings Bank Account or Jan Dhan account number with an Indian Financial System Code
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Applicant must not hold membership in EPFO, NPS or ESIC schemes

caveats: Applicant must not be engaged in the organized sector
Applicant must not be a member of NPS-Traders scheme
Applicant must make regular age-specific monthly contributions
Savings Bank Account or Jan Dhan account number must have an Indian Financial System Code
Both voluntary and involuntary exits from the scheme are permitted only after completion of three years from the date of enrolment in the scheme
documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook / Jan-Dhan Account Passbook
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit the nearest Common Services Centre (CSC) to initiate registration and enrollment; the Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) keys in Aadhaar details, captures further details including bank account, mobile number, email-id, spouse and nominee details, self-certification is completed, the system calculates the monthly contribution, the subscriber pays the first subscription in cash, an Enrolment Form cum Auto Debit mandate is signed and uploaded, and a Shram Yogi Pension Account Number and Shram Yogi Card are generated.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.summary: PM SVANidhi is a central-sector micro-credit scheme to provide handholding support to street vendors, facilitating a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy.
schemes.benefits: The scheme facilitates a working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000, with subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 with a 7% interest subsidy. To incentivize the adoption of digital transactions, a cashback of up to ₹100 per month is given to Street Vendors.

rules.reason: Scheme is for street vendors

caveats: Applicant must be a street vendor in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by ULBs, OR identified in the survey but not issued the card, OR left out of the ULB-led identification survey / started vending after survey completion with an LoR from ULB/TVC, OR a vendor of surrounding development/peri-urban/rural areas vending in ULB geographical limits with an LoR from ULB/TVC
Survey Reference Number (SRN) is mandatory for online application
Applicant must be a vendor identified in the survey but not issued Certificate of Vending / Identity Card
Applicant must be a street vendor left out of the ULB-led identification survey or who started vending after completion of the survey and issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) by ULB/TVC
Applicant must be a vendor of surrounding development/peri-urban/rural areas vending in the geographical limits of the ULBs, issued a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) by ULB/TVC
documents: Copy of Membership Card/any other proof of membership
Any other document to substantiate the claim as a vendor
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in/ and click on the "Log In" button on the homepage. Enter Mobile number and captcha. Click request OTP. After successful login, select valid "vendor category" among the available options. Enter "Survey Reference Number" (SRN) which is mandatory. On entering these basic details, fill the application form online, upload the relevant documents and submit.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.summary: Central Sector Scheme providing recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive, collateral-free credit, digital transaction incentives and marketing support to artisans and craftspeople.
schemes.benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma through Certificate and ID Card; Skill Verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) of Basic Training; 15 days (120 hours) of Advanced Training; Training Stipend: ₹ 500 per day; Toolkit Incentive: ₹ 15,000 grant; Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans: ₹ 1,00,000 (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) & ₹ 2,00,000 (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment); Concessional Rate of Interest: 5% with Interest Subvention cap of 8% paid by MoMSME; Credit Guarantee fees borne by GoI; Incentive for Digital Transaction: ₹ 1 per transaction for a maximum of up to 100 transactions (monthly); Marketing Support through National Committee for Marketing.

rules.reason: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools
Applicant must be engaged in the unorganized sector on a self-employment basis
Applicant must be at least 18 years old on the date of registration
A person in government service and their family members are not eligible

caveats: Applicant should be engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades mentioned in the scheme
Applicant should be engaged in the concerned trade on the date of registration

Applicant should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of the Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra, in the past 5 years
Registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family
Family members of a person in government service are not eligible
Verification of Eligibility at Gram Panchayat or ULB level; Vetting and Recommendation by the District Implementation Committee; Final approval by the Screening Committee
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online via Common Service Centres (CSCs) by enrolling through the nearest CSC, completing biometric verification, and submitting the online application form.
